memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Say to them: "This is the food offering you are to present to the LORD: two lambs a year old without defect, as a regular burnt offering each day. Offer one lamb in the morning and the other at twilight, together with a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with a quarter of a hin of oil from pressed olives." - Num 28:3-5 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
At the heart of Israel's worship was the daily burnt offering: one lamb in the morning and one at twilight, day after day, without fail. This regular offering framed each day with worship. From sunrise to sunset, the smoke rising from the altar reminded Israel that they belonged to God and lived in His presence continually.

There is something beautiful in this daily rhythm. Worship was not reserved for special occasions but woven into the fabric of ordinary life. Morning and evening, God's people turned toward Him. This teaches us the value of consistent, daily devotion, bookending our days with time turned toward the Lord.

We should remember that these particular sacrifices belonged to the old covenant and are fulfilled in Christ. We do not offer lambs each morning and evening. Yet the principle of daily communion with God remains precious. A life turned toward God at the start and close of each day is a life anchored in His presence.

The daily lamb pointed forward to the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world (John 1:29). Where Israel needed a lamb every morning and evening, we have one Lamb whose single sacrifice is sufficient forever. Because of Him, we can walk in unbroken fellowship with God all day long. Let each morning and evening turn your heart to Christ, the Lamb who was slain for you.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you begin and end your days turned toward God?
2. How does the daily lamb point you to Christ, the Lamb of God?
3. What would consistent daily devotion look like in your life?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord Jesus, You are the Lamb of God whose one sacrifice is enough forever. Help me to turn my heart to You each morning and evening, walking in unbroken fellowship with the Father. Amen.
